output.summary: A foul-smelling shrub native to the southern United States, Mexico and South America, coffee senna has broad paired leaflets and yellow flowers in small groups. It flowers throughout the year and is an aggressive tropical weed.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves have long been eaten in Maldivian dishes, but sufficient intake may poison humans; seeds used as food in India have been linked to fatal childhood encephalopathy.
